d.seg: मग काय करू आता मैं विडियो कॉल सर्विस दिते कॉन्ट्रॅक्ट नंबर
d.tr: So what should I do now, I provide video call service, contact number
d.ctx: The expert discusses moving to WhatsApp for video calls because of app blurring and coin costs. The user responds about the number.
d.j: Proposing to move contact to an external app/number, matching a strong case.

d.seg: नंबर वन म्हणजे व्हाट्सअप ला तुला पाजिये असॅल जर विड्यो कहल सर्विस तो मी तुला दिते थ्री हंड्रेड चार्जेस एक मिनट
d.tr: Number means if you want on WhatsApp for video call service, I will give it to you for 300 charges, one minute
d.ctx: The expert offers her WhatsApp number for video calls and states the charges. The user asks for the number next.
d.j: Proposing to move to WhatsApp and giving terms, matching a strong case.

d.seg: चौरासी एट फौर चौरा चौरासी एकोणसाठ एकोणसाठ एकोणपचास
d.ctx: The expert dictates her phone number for contacting outside the app. The user listens and repeats.
d.j: Giving a phone number, matching a strong case for PlatformMove.
